challenge.results: The detail resolves at the tag’s target commit. SPDX explicitly explains that the main clause resembles Classpath-exception-2.0 and gives the LGPL use and different lead-in as reasons for a separate ID. The exact ID, cited RTL path and text support this correspondence. No inspected binding supports a merge with either Classpath entry or an election by another project. Neither Classpath record was independently opened for a full textual comparison.

limitations: The SPDX text and publisher notice share a source lineage. Their correspondence supplies no independent corroboration of a separate grant.
The template marks the opening scope sentence optional and the library name replaceable. A different matching witness would need its own publisher and applicability evidence.
The tag is unsigned. The repository tag object establishes the release target without authenticating a tagger signature.
